title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30419: add time sheet filtering events
summary: Integration events are added to report 952 Suggest Job Jnl. Lines to allow extensions to filter time sheet headers and lines before they are processed.
key_points: Two new filter-stage events added to FillTimeSheetLineBuffer method
Extensions can narrow time sheet headers and lines with custom criteria
Events fire after standard filters are applied but before FindSet
Preserves standard report processing while enabling customization
Allows subscribers to refine record sets during report execution
quote: Extensions need to narrow the time sheet headers and lines processed by report 952 before records are read.
